description: This file defines a utility enum 'LogLocator' that manages log file locations, creation, and retrieval, primarily for locating the most recent log files in a specified directory, as well as providing paths for launchd.”

classes.name: LogLocator
classes.description: A static utility enum for locating and managing log files related to the application.

methods.name: bestLogFile
methods.description: Returns the most recent log file in the log directory based on modification date, or nil if none exist.

methods.name: launchdLogPath
methods.description: Provides the file path for launchd stdout/stderr logs.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Provides the file path for Gateway launchd job logs.
